id.description: ID of the Smart Link in the content tree.

type.description: The content type of the object.

title.description: Title of the Smart Link in the content tree.

parentId.description: ID of the parent content, or null if there is no parent content.

position.description: Position of the Smart Link within the given parent page tree.

authorId.description: The account ID of the user who created this Smart Link in the content tree originally.

ownerId.description: The account ID of the user who owns this Smart Link in the content tree.

createdAt.description: Date and time when the Smart Link in the content tree was created. In format "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ".

embedUrl.description: The embedded URL of the Smart Link. If the Smart Link does not have an embedded URL, this property will not be included in the response.

spaceId.description: ID of the space the Smart Link is in.
